Good — this is the only `*AgentTest.java` in the project, and the full suite confirms the same single failure.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` with 76 self-contained JUnit 4 tests covering predefined formats, `newFormat`, all `with*` mutators, `validate()` error cases, `equals`/`hashCode`, `toString`, `format`/`print`/`println`/`printRecord`, quote-mode behavior, and defensive copying of array fields.

**75 tests pass. 1 test fails, exposing a real bug:**

- `testWithRecordSeparatorRejectsInvalidValue` — `CSVFormat.withRecordSeparator(String)` is documented (`@throws IllegalArgumentException if recordSeparator is none of CR, LF or CRLF`) to reject separators other than CR, LF, or CRLF, but the implementation performs no such validation — `CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withRecordSeparator("XYZ")` silently succeeds and returns a format with `recordSeparator == "XYZ"` instead of throwing.
